spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  summary_date AS `date`,
  overall_sentiment,
  source_post_count AS posts,
  hot_tickers,
  summary
FROM daily_market_summary
WHERE summary_date = (SELECT MAX(summary_date) FROM daily_market_summary WHERE $__timeFilter(generated_at))

spec.description: Claude's full market summary for the latest day inside the selected time range. Narrow the time picker (top-right) to a single day to read any past date.
spec.title: Daily Market Summary — selected day

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  t.symbol,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT s.status) AS phase,
  r.action,
  ROUND(r.confidence * 100, 0) AS `confidence %`,
  LEFT(r.reasoning, 300) AS reasoning
FROM recommendations r
JOIN tickers t ON r.ticker_id = t.id
LEFT JOIN v_ticker_status_multi s ON s.ticker_id = t.id
WHERE DATE(r.generated_at) = (SELECT MAX(DATE(generated_at)) FROM recommendations WHERE $__timeFilter(generated_at))
GROUP BY r.id, t.symbol, r.action, r.confidence, r.reasoning
ORDER BY r.confidence DESC, t.symbol

spec.description: Every per-ticker recommendation generated on the selected day. 'phase' = whether you hold it (HOLDING) or it's on your watchlist (WATCHLIST); 'action' = what Claude recommends. They diverge on the actionable rows (e.g. HOLDING+SELL, WATCHLIST+BUY).
spec.title: Recommendations — selected day

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  theme,
  direction,
  LEFT(summary, 300) AS summary
FROM macro_signals
WHERE DATE(detected_at) = (SELECT MAX(DATE(detected_at)) FROM macro_signals WHERE $__timeFilter(detected_at))
ORDER BY detected_at DESC

spec.description: Macro/sector themes Claude detected from headlines on the selected day.
spec.title: Macro Signals — selected day

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  MAX(post_score) AS score,
  post_title,
  MAX(post_url) AS url
FROM reddit_mentions
WHERE DATE(captured_at) = (SELECT MAX(DATE(captured_at)) FROM reddit_mentions WHERE $__timeFilter(captured_at))
GROUP BY post_id, post_title
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 15

spec.description: Highest-scoring /r/stocks posts captured on the selected day.
spec.title: Top Reddit Posts — selected day

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  UNIX_TIMESTAMP(r.generated_at) AS time_sec,
  t.symbol AS metric,
  CASE r.action
    WHEN 'BUY' THEN 2 WHEN 'WATCH' THEN 1 WHEN 'HOLD' THEN 0
    WHEN 'AVOID' THEN -1 WHEN 'SELL' THEN -2 END AS value
FROM recommendations r
JOIN tickers t ON r.ticker_id = t.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(r.generated_at)
ORDER BY r.generated_at, t.symbol

spec.description: Recommended action per ticker over time, encoded SELL(-2) / AVOID(-1) / HOLD(0) / WATCH(+1) / BUY(+2). Higher = more bullish.
spec.title: Action History by Ticker

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  DATE(r.generated_at) AS `date`,
  t.symbol,
  r.action,
  ROUND(r.confidence * 100, 0) AS `confidence %`,
  LEFT(r.reasoning, 200) AS reasoning
FROM recommendations r
JOIN tickers t ON r.ticker_id = t.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(r.generated_at)
ORDER BY r.generated_at DESC, t.symbol

spec.description: Every recommendation over time, newest first. Filter by symbol via the column header; widen the time range for more history.
spec.title: Action History (all tickers)

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  DATE(o.generated_at) AS `date`,
  t.symbol,
  o.action,
  o.horizon_days AS `horizon (d)`,
  ROUND(o.forward_return * 100, 2) AS `return %`,
  o.verdict
FROM recommendation_outcomes o
JOIN tickers t ON o.ticker_id = t.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(o.generated_at)
ORDER BY o.generated_at DESC, t.symbol, o.horizon_days

spec.description: How past recommendations played out: forward return at each horizon and the verdict. Populated by `python -m src.evaluate_outcomes`.
spec.title: Recommendation Outcomes

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  action,
  horizon_days AS `horizon (d)`,
  COUNT(*) AS total,
  SUM(verdict = 'CORRECT') AS correct,
  SUM(verdict = 'INCORRECT') AS incorrect,
  ROUND(100 * SUM(verdict = 'CORRECT') /
    NULLIF(SUM(verdict IN ('CORRECT','INCORRECT')), 0), 0) AS `hit rate %`
FROM recommendation_outcomes
GROUP BY action, horizon_days
ORDER BY FIELD(action,'BUY','SELL','WATCH','HOLD','AVOID'), horizon_days

spec.description: Share of decided (non-neutral) outcomes that were correct, per action and horizon.
spec.title: Hit Rate by Action

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  DATE(r2.generated_at)            AS day,
  t.symbol,
  DATE(r1.generated_at)            AS `prev day`,
  r1.action                        AS `prev action`,
  r2.action                        AS `new action`,
  ROUND(r1.confidence * 100, 0)    AS `prev conf %`,
  ROUND(r2.confidence * 100, 0)    AS `new conf %`
FROM recommendations r2
JOIN recommendations r1
  ON r1.ticker_id = r2.ticker_id
 AND r1.generated_at = (
   SELECT MAX(r3.generated_at) FROM recommendations r3
   WHERE r3.ticker_id = r2.ticker_id AND r3.generated_at < r2.generated_at
 )
 AND r1.action <> r2.action
JOIN tickers t ON t.id = r2.ticker_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(r2.generated_at)
ORDER BY day DESC, t.symbol

spec.description: Tickers whose action flipped between consecutive runs (each row joins a run to its immediately-preceding run for the same ticker). Under the single daily cron these are day-over-day flips — the model changing its call vs the prior trading day.
spec.title: Action flips vs previous run (D1)

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE(generated_at)) AS time_sec,
  SUM(action = 'BUY')   AS BUY,
  SUM(action = 'WATCH') AS WATCH,
  SUM(action = 'HOLD')  AS HOLD,
  SUM(action = 'AVOID') AS AVOID,
  SUM(action = 'SELL')  AS SELL
FROM recommendations
WHERE $__timeFilter(generated_at)
GROUP BY time_sec
ORDER BY time_sec

spec.description: How the action mix shifts day over day (stacked counts per action). Watch for WATCH/HOLD share giving way to decisive BUY/SELL calls after the prompt rework.
spec.title: Action mix over time (D2)

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN o.confidence >= 0.8 THEN '0.80+'
       WHEN o.confidence >= 0.6 THEN '0.60-0.79'
       WHEN o.confidence >= 0.4 THEN '0.40-0.59'
       ELSE '< 0.40' END AS `confidence band`,
  o.action,
  COUNT(*) AS total,
  SUM(o.verdict = 'CORRECT')   AS correct,
  SUM(o.verdict = 'INCORRECT') AS incorrect,
  SUM(o.verdict = 'NEUTRAL')   AS neutral,
  ROUND(100 * SUM(o.verdict = 'CORRECT') /
    NULLIF(SUM(o.verdict IN ('CORRECT','INCORRECT')), 0), 0) AS `hit rate %`
FROM recommendation_outcomes o
WHERE o.horizon_days = 30
GROUP BY `confidence band`, o.action
ORDER BY FIELD(`confidence band`, '0.80+', '0.60-0.79', '0.40-0.59', '< 0.40'),
         FIELD(o.action, 'BUY', 'SELL', 'WATCH', 'HOLD', 'AVOID')

spec.description: Calibration check over all graded outcomes: is the model's self-reported confidence informative? Hit rate is correct / decided (NEUTRAL excluded), per confidence band and action. Well-calibrated = hit rate rises with the band.
spec.title: Hit Rate by Confidence Band (D3, 30d)

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  week_start                      AS `week of`,
  generated_at,
  stats->>'$.outcomes.hit_rate_pct' AS `hit rate % (30d)`,
  retrospective
FROM weekly_retrospectives
WHERE week_start = (SELECT MAX(week_start) FROM weekly_retrospectives WHERE $__timeFilter(generated_at))

spec.description: S5: Claude's week-in-review for a long-term investor — how the calls whose 30d horizon matured this week graded, the week's action flips, and sector exposure. Written on Friday runs; shows the latest week inside the selected time range. Empty until the first Friday run after the S5 merge.
spec.title: Retrospectiva semanal (S5, 30d)

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE(r2.generated_at)) AS time_sec,
  COUNT(*)                              AS flips
FROM recommendations r2
JOIN recommendations r1
  ON r1.ticker_id = r2.ticker_id
 AND r1.generated_at = (
   SELECT MAX(r3.generated_at) FROM recommendations r3
   WHERE r3.ticker_id = r2.ticker_id AND r3.generated_at < r2.generated_at
 )
 AND r1.action <> r2.action
WHERE $__timeFilter(r2.generated_at)
GROUP BY time_sec
ORDER BY time_sec

spec.description: Flip-stability watch: how many tickers changed action vs their previous run, per day. The long-term prompt (session 14) tells the model not to flip on weekly noise — a sustained high bar count here means that instruction needs reinforcement. Expect a one-day spike right after any prompt change.
spec.title: Action flips per run

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  symbol,
  first_seen    AS `first seen`,
  last_seen     AS `last seen`,
  times_seen    AS `runs trending`,
  mention_count AS `posts (latest run)`,
  avg_score     AS `avg score (latest run)`
FROM trending_tickers
ORDER BY last_seen DESC, times_seen DESC
LIMIT 50

spec.description: Candidates to watchlist: symbols trending in high-score Reddit posts that aren't in the tickers table (migration 004; persisted each run). A symbol trending across many runs is a stronger signal than one spike. Empty until Reddit credentials are configured.
spec.title: Trending tickers not in watchlist
